100 finite steps; mean/median 6.261649/6.24 s per step; mean/median 163.535/164.103 samples/s. Peak memory 96,500/183,359 MiB (52.63%); per-GPU average utilization 63.01%-67.31%. Aligned/zero/shuffle loss 0.0083108954/0.0093276529/0.0091043524; gains 10.90046%/8.71514%. Complete 8-rank 93,930,527,997-byte checkpoint.

All preregistered stability, checkpoint, memory, throughput, and intervention gates passed. Disabling checkpointing and using B128 raised peak memory substantially, but mean throughput improved only about 2.2% over the approximately 160 samples/s R7 reference and average GPU utilization remained about 65%. Run one bounded B192 probe before selecting the 20k configuration; optimize for samples/s and formal wall-clock, not allocated memory alone.
